title: Wellington DF639 SLOD Panel, Schuinesloot
memorial_details: A memorial panel erected by SLOD (Stichting Luchtoorlog Onderzoek Drenthe — Foundation for Air War Research Drenthe). No. 75 (New Zealand) Squadron flew Wellingtons through 1941 and into 1942; a Wellington serial in the DF range would date the loss to this period, before the squadron converted to Stirlings in October 1942. SLOD panels are the product of meticulous local archival research combining Dutch, German, and British records. The slodrenthe.nl website returned a 403 error at the time of research; SLOD's Facebook presence is active.
crew_summary: Crew details not yet confirmed from accessible sources.
